'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Jonny Chu LS Echo Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jonny Chu]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jonny Chu]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Main Power Generators|Hoth-L-hothmainpowergenerators.gif}}
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
